svg.title: Job Portal System architecture
svg.desc: React frontend calls a Spring Cloud API gateway. The gateway routes to eight Spring Boot services through Eureka discovery. Six services own PostgreSQL databases. Job and company services use Redis. Application status events flow through Kafka to notification email via MailHog. The AI service calls Gemini.
svg.text: React → API Gateway → Spring Boot services → PostgreSQL · Redis · Kafka
Solid arrows: request / event flow · Dashed arrows: discovery, configuration, or data dependency
